old_content: Support groups, whether in person or online, offer a safe space to share experiences, gain advice, and connect with others facing similar challenges. Being part of a community can combat isolation and provide a sense of belonging.
new_content: Support groups, whether in person or online, offer a safe space to share experiences, gain advice, and connect with others facing similar challenges. Being part of a community can combat isolation and provide a sense of belonging. For a Singapore peer-support resource, see the Lymphatics Association of Singapore.
